newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON END LIONS' UNBEATEN RUN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON END LIONS' UNBEATEN RUN.

text.p: Super 12 leaders Gauteng Lions lost their unbeaten record when they lost 37-35 to Wellington Hurricanes at Ellis Park on Saturday.
The New Zealanders clinched the victory with a 79th minute penalty by scrum-half Jon Preston.
Preston kicked 22 points, six penalties and two conversions, and was responsible for ensuring that his side did not waste a three try burst in the first 16 minutes.
All Black full-back Christian Cullen scored two of Wellington's three tries on his return from injury.
Centre Jason O'Halloran scored the third from a charge down of an attempted Lions clearance kick and with Preston adding the conversion the visitors forged an early 19-3 lead.
The Lions, formerly Transvaal, fought back with tries from centre Joe Gillingham and flanker Piet Krause and the teams turned around at 20-25.
The Lions scored two more tries in the second period to earn a bonus point and kept their own line intact.
But technical infringements gave Preston the chance to keep Wellington in front, which he did with aplomb, missing only one of nine attempts on the day.
The Lions went ahead for the first time in the 68th minute when springbok centre Japie Mulder crossed the line to make it 32-31.

Lions fullback Gavin Johnson exchanged kicks with Preston in the dying minutes, but Preston had the last laugh, converting his sixth and decisive penalty when the Lions were penalised for using hands in the maul.

The two point margin of defeat gave the Lions a second bonus point and they still lead the standings with 20 points from five games. Wellington have 11 points from four games and play Natal next week in Durban.

Gauteng Lions - Gavin Johnson; Dawie du Toit (Riaan van Jaarsveld 62 mins), Japie Mulder, Joe Gillingham, Jannie van der Walt; Hennie le Roux (Ken Ford 48 mins), Johan Roux; Andre Vos, Ian Macdonald, Piet Krause, Hannes Strydom, Kobus Wiese (captain),Kapstok van Greuning (Roberto Grau 65 mins), Chris Rossouw, Balie Swart.

Wellington - Christian Cullen; Tana Umaga, Alama Ieremia, Jason O'Halloran, Alex Tell; Stephen Backup, Jon Preston; Karl William's, Martin Leslie (Fin Make 72 ins), Christen Advise, Mark Cooksley, Dion Waller, Bill Cavubati (Phil Coffin 61 ins), Norm Hewitt, Mark Allen (captain).
